title: Change Owner follow-ups: bulk entry is grid-only (kanban/gallery have none) and the queue picker stops at 200
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35403 (PR #36343, Change Owner in the console). Found by the L2 record 7077265450 on PR #36343 (S2, N2); filed by the seat. Parent: #35403.

## What happens

1. **`onBulkChangeOwner` on `ListView` does nothing over a non-grid view (S2).** Its doc says so, but a kanban, calendar or gallery view of the same object offers no bulk Change Owner, and nothing tracks the gap.
2. **The owner picker's queue list caps at 200 with no search (N2).** The dialog reads `sys_queue` with `$top: 200` and no search box, so an org with more queues silently cannot pick the rest.

## To do

1. Decide per view type whether a selection exists (kanban and gallery select; calendar may not). Wire bulk Change Owner where a selection exists, or state in the view's doc and the console that it is grid-only.
2. Give the queue tab a server-side search like the user tab, or page it. Pin it with 201 queues.

## Acceptance

- On a kanban view, a user who can transfer selects two cards and changes their owner, or the view says plainly that bulk Change Owner is list-only.
- A queue beyond the 200th can be found and picked.

Blocked-by: #36343

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui.
